ov: كوكتيل (الإنجليزية: Cocktail) هو فيلم دراما تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 1988. من بطولة توم كروز وإليزابيث شو. فيلم دراما أمريكي من إصدار عام 1988 في أمريكا مدة الفيلم 103 دقيقة بالغة الإنكليزية انشء الفيلم بميزانية قدرها 11مليون دولار أمريكي وحصل على أرباح قدرها 171504781 دولار أمريكي الفيلم من بطولة توم كروز وبراين بني واليزابيث شو وانتاج تيد الميدا وروبرت دبيلو كورت واخراج روجر دونالدسون
plotEn:
Brian Flanagan is a cocky, naïve, ambitious, charismatic, and initially shallow young man who seeks both get-rich-quick methods and the powerful status it brings.
Brian, recently discharged from the U.S. Army, heads home to New York City where he hopes to land a high-powered business job. He fails and instead works as a bartender while attending business school.
Brian meets Doug Coughlin, an experienced bartender who teaches him flair bartending. Doug wants to open a nationwide chain of bars called Cocktails & Dreams. Brian drops out of business school, and the two become popular bartenders at a trendy nightclub.
Their flairing act attracts Coral, a wealthy photographer, and she and Brian start dating. Doug bets Brian that the relationship will not last and, unbeknownst to the latter, seduces Coral. When Brian finds out, he and Doug dissolve their partnership.
Two years later, Brian is working at a beachside bar in Jamaica, hoping to save enough for his own establishment. He meets artist Jordan Mooney, and they begin a passionate relationship. Doug shows up, married to the wealthy, flirtatious, and much younger Kerry. Doug bets Brian that he cannot attract Bonnie, a wealthy older woman. Brian accepts his challenge and wins Bonnie over. Jordan sees them going to the motel together. The next morning, Brian regrets the fling and seeks out Jordan but she has returned to the United States.
